title: IceCube DeepCore data constrain long-range neutrino interactions
summary: First located in an arXiv version posted January 3, 2026, this study received a journal version on November 20 with revised event-score bins. It uses trained boosted-decision-tree scores from IceCube’s pre-applied classification pipeline to group released DeepCore events for oscillation fits. Analyzing eight years of atmospheric-neutrino data, the authors find no evidence for the tested long-range interactions and report constraints on their coupling strengths. The result depends on the specified physical hypotheses and experimental systematics; the classifier identifies event topology and was not newly trained by these authors.
ai_technology: IceCube-pipeline boosted decision tree particle-identification classifier
organization: Institute of Physics, Bhubaneswar; Aligarh Muslim University; Homi Bhabha National Institute

evidence.tested: The arXiv v1 and peer-reviewed article analyze the released eight-year IceCube DeepCore high-purity νμ charged-current sample. The source describes a trained boosted decision tree that calculates a tracklike particle-identification score; the score defines mixed/tracklike event bins used in the fits. The published version reports constraints and no evidence for long-range interactions.
evidence.unknown: The search found no evidence for long-range interactions. Results depend on the released sample, detector/flux/cross-section systematics, and the tested interaction hypotheses. The paper states that the event sample selection/reconstruction procedures were already applied by IceCube and that the sample was used without modification; the evidence does not establish that these authors trained a new classifier for this paper.
evidence.ai_role: A trained boosted decision tree in the IceCube event-classification pipeline supplied particle-identification scores representing event tracklikeness. The study used these scores to define event-topology bins for its forward-folded oscillation fits. The study reused the IceCube golden-event sample without modification; do not attribute fresh model training to the paper’s authors.

source_review.scope: Official arXiv API identity and posting date; arXiv v1 and APS publisher PDFs, including abstracts, BDT particle-identification/binning Methods, main constraint results and conclusions.
